intro.text: Welcome to Segfault City. Your first stop is the Toy Workshop, where clockwork robots wait for instructions that never come.
Quack. A computer does exactly what you tell it, no more. Break the job into small steps, and repeat the ones that repeat.

mid.text: The robots move. But the workshop's lights speak a stranger language: lamps that are only ever on or off.
Quack. Everything a computer stores is made of those on/off bits. Eight bits make a byte, and a byte can hold a number up to 255.

outro.text: Robots walking, lamps glowing. You've just done what every program does: algorithms plus data.
Quack. Next stop: the Foundry, where we speak to the machine in C.

games.title: Program the Robot
games.instructions: Build a program from blocks and press Run. Repeat blocks wrap the next block you add. Beat par for 3 stars.

games.title: Light the Lamps
games.instructions: Each lamp is a bit. Click to switch it on, and the number underneath is its weight. Add the lit weights.

targets.prompt: Show 65, the ASCII code for the letter A.
targets.explain: 65 = 64 + 1. Computers store the letter A as that number.
